title: Paseo: Control Your Dev Workflow from Your Phone

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: You kicked off a massive refactor, stepped away from your desk, and now you're flying blind. Po runs a lightweight Damon on your machine and connects your phone via end toend encrypted relay. Dictate feature requests with pushto talk. Watch live terminal output stream to your phone in real time. Review diffs. Approve terminal commands remotely. Zero forced accounts. Zero cloud telemetry.
